onnx.normalization: RGB, centre-square crop (camera: the guide box), shrink to <= 448 px, area-resize to 224x224, /255, ImageNet mean/std, NCHW float32

models.notes: REAL baseline model (MobileNetV3-Large, fine-tuned, int8 per-channel weights). 20 classes: 19 skin conditions + healthy-skin (green). tierRule 'thresholds' (sensitivity-first): red if P(red) >= tierThresholds.red, else amber if P(amber)+P(red) >= tierThresholds.amber, else amber if the top class is nevus/seborrheic keratosis, melanoma is the runner-up and P(melanoma) >= guard.minWatchProb (guard), or an enclosed very dark spot covers >= darkSpot.minArea of the box (darkSpot), else uncertain if P(green) < threshold, else green. T, thresholds fitted on the validation split only. Input is the centre square (guide box) of the photo. Screening aid, not a diagnosis. Tiers of SCIN-derived classes are provisional (clinician review needed). See docs/model-cards/skin-v1.md.

MOCK. No audio class is red on purpose: a short phone recording of lung sounds cannot establish urgency, so abnormal sounds only ever advise a clinician visit (amber). Threshold 0.5 (4 classes) and temperature 1.5 are placeholders.

Real signal processing, no model. Label from breaths/min: <12 slow, 12-20 normal, >20 fast. Tier is escalated by rate in code (src/inference/resp.ts respTier): 12-20 green; 10-11 or 21-24 amber; <10 or >24 red (adult resting). The manifest tier here is the label default. Low signal quality => uncertain.
Logistic regression over modality severities, weights in src/inference/fusion-weights.json (UNTRAINED placeholder). Threshold 0.45 for 3 classes.
